title: (De)habituation support
body:
I’ve used the app for a couple of weeks now, and really like the interface and functionality. It’s a great assistant for tracking and establishing (or discarding) habits. 

 Feedback about the interface: it would be great if there was a direct access to editing a habit straight from the habit view without having to go via the Habit Manager.

I also miss some documentation. Is there any?  What is the difference between Skip, Hide and simply not doing anything to a habit-entry. Does it show up
differently in history and statistics, and what is the purpose of each of these ways of interacting?
